# Finder open companion

Double-click this file in Finder while [the main fixture](finder-open.md) is open.
It must become a second tab in the same window, and the window must come forward.

| Marker | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Companion | $x^2$ |

> A document arriving from Finder joins the running window, as a second launch does.

## Tabs off

Turn **Open files in tabs** off in Settings, then quit Qinta. Double-click the main
fixture: it still opens in the window that starts, not beside an empty start page.
Now double-click this file: it opens in its own, second window.
